sections.title: Richard O. Holley, *CPA*

image.alt: A road under a canopy of live oaks

body: Richard was born and raised in Aiken. He graduated cum laude from Clemson University with a B.S. in Financial Management and a minor in Accounting, then began his career in 2006 with a regional accounting firm in Augusta, providing business valuation services and earning his Certified Valuation Analyst designation.

After further accounting study at Augusta State University, he earned his CPA license in 2011, and later moved to the firm’s Aiken office to serve his hometown. He serves on the board of the Rotary Club of Aiken and was named a Rising Star by the Aiken Young Professionals.
list: Rotary Club of Aiken board member

columns.title: Reliability
items: Knowledge and experience you can count on

items.q: My books are a mess. Where do I start?
items.a: Call us. We’ll take over your bookkeeping and get your records in order, so you can get back to running your business.

items.q: Can you help if I owe the IRS?
items.a: Yes. We help resolve tax problems efficiently, affordably and discreetly.

items.q: Do you work with individuals or only businesses?
items.a: Both. We prepare individual returns and serve small businesses, from the self-employed to companies with employees.
Yes: setup, training, tune-ups and answers to your questions.
